# Godrej Park World Hinjewadi - The Aqua Retreat

> Ultra-Luxury 2 & 3 BHK Resort-Style Residences in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune by Godrej Properties.

## Overview
- **Project Name**: Godrej Park World - The Aqua Retreat
- **Developer**: Godrej Properties Pune (Authorised Channel Partner Website)
- **MahaRERA Registration Number**: PM1260002500070 (Official link: https://maharera.mahaonline.gov.in)
- **Location**: Hinjewadi Phase 1, Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park, Pune, Maharashtra 411057, India
- **Total Township Area**: 100+ Acres Integrated Township
- **Central Greens Area**: 12+ Acres of Unobstructed Botanical Greens
- **Clubhouse**: 50,000 sq. ft. Multi-Tier Luxury Clubhouse with Lagoon Infinity Pool

## Configurations & Indicative Pricing
- **2 BHK Luxury Residence**: 750 - 820 Sq. Ft. Carpet Area | Starting ₹1.10 Crore* - ₹1.35 Crore*
- **3 BHK Regal Residence**: 1060 - 1250 Sq. Ft. Carpet Area | Starting ₹1.65 Crore* - ₹2.50 Crore*
- **Rental Yield Potential**: 6.5% - 8.0% Annual Rental Yield in Hinjewadi IT Park Corridor

## Key Amenities & Features
- 50,000 sq. ft. Signature Aqua Clubhouse
- Multi-tier lagoon infinity pools, sunken cabanas, and cascading waterfalls
- 12+ acres of central greens, botanical trails, and outdoor amphitheater
- Smart home automation, EV charging bays, and biometric security
- 2 minutes from Hinjewadi Metro Station (Line 3)
- 5 minutes from Infosys, Wipro, TCS, and Embassy TechZone
